architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. Tailwind CSS for styling. React Router for navigation. No state management lib (useState + context for now).

tickets.title: Landing page skeleton (src/pages/Landing.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch screen `sentra_security_reinvented` to React. Extract hero section, tagline, CTA buttons. Preserve exact layout, spacing, typography. Use Tailwind classes from style guide.
acceptance_criteria: Pixel-perfect match to Stitch screen
Responsive down to 320px width
All text content editable via props or i18n keys
CTA buttons log click events to console (placeholder for analytics)

tickets.title: Style guide extraction (src/styles/theme.js)
tickets.description: Extract color palette, typography scale, spacing units, shadows, borders from `obsidian_protocol_style_guide`. Export as Tailwind config object. Document breakpoints, animation tokens.
acceptance_criteria: All Stitch colors mapped to Tailwind `theme.extend.colors`
Typography scale matches Stitch (font-family, weight, size, line-height)
Spacing system uses Tailwind `theme.extend.spacing` (4px base unit)
Dark mode classes match Stitch dark variants

tickets.title: Shared component library (src/components/)
tickets.description: Build reusable components from `component_showcase_buttons_cards`. Focus: PrimaryButton, SecondaryButton, Card, Badge. Use extracted style guide. Support disabled, loading, icon variants.
acceptance_criteria: Props match Stitch variants (size, color, state)
Hover/focus/active states pixel-perfect
Accessible (keyboard nav, ARIA labels)
Storybook stories for each component (ponytail: add Storybook later)

tickets.title: Feature section modules (src/pages/Landing.jsx)
tickets.description: Extract feature grid, testimonials, stats from landing screen. Build as reusable modules. Use shared Card component. Preserve animations (fade-in on scroll).
acceptance_criteria: Modules match Stitch layout (grid columns, gutters)
Animations use native IntersectionObserver (ponytail: replace with Framer Motion later)
Content editable via props or CMS keys

tickets.title: Navigation bar and footer (src/components/Layout.jsx)
tickets.description: Build responsive navbar (desktop/mobile menu). Extract footer from landing screen. Use shared Button components. Navbar sticky on scroll. Footer links functional (placeholder routes).
acceptance_criteria: Navbar collapses to hamburger menu < 768px
Active route highlighted
Footer social icons link to external URLs (noopener noreferrer)
Dark/light mode toggle functional (localStorage persistence)

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router. Wrap app in Layout component. Configure routes for landing page. Add 404 page. Navbar/footer persist across routes. Dark mode context provider.
acceptance_criteria: Routes match: `/` → Landing, `*` → NotFound
Layout persists across routes
Router uses lazy loading (ponytail: add later)
Dark mode toggle updates app-wide state
